name: Mind map
description: A ```mindmap block for pages and whiteboards: an indented outline (spaces, tabs or "- " lists) drawn as a mind map with the first line in the middle and its branches to both sides. Readers collapse and expand branches and copy the map onto a whiteboard as shapes.
